corpus: UCI Heart Disease: four hospitals, as FLamby's Fed-Heart-Disease prepares them
provenance: The processed Cleveland, Hungarian, Switzerland and VA Long Beach files of the UCI Heart Disease dataset (Janosi, Steinbrunn, Pfisterer and Detrano, 1988), each checked against the MD5 FLamby's download script checks, prepared as FLamby's Fed-Heart-Disease prepares them (du Terrail et al., NeurIPS 2022 Datasets and Benchmarks). Each centre is one real hospital.
attribution: Janosi, A., Steinbrunn, W., Pfisterer, M. and Detrano, R. (1988). Heart Disease. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C52P4X
modifications: Columns slope, ca and thal dropped and rows with a missing value removed; chest-pain type and resting ECG dummy-coded with the first level dropped; the diagnosis binarised (0 against 1 to 4); each hospital split 66/34 (scikit-learn, random_state 43, stratified where each class has more than two rows) and standardised with its own training rows' mean and sample standard deviation; values written as the shortest decimals that read back as float32.
label: heart disease (num 1 to 4) against none (num 0)
split: per hospital, 66 percent training and 34 percent test, scikit-learn random_state 43

centres.name: University Hospitals of Zurich and Basel
